issue.title: Setup - CI/CD
issue.description:
## 🔧 Tech Story
As a developer,
I want to setup CI/CD elements,
so to automise my workflow, reduce human related errors, and facilitate deployment.

## 📋Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Dockerfile for for building an image of the app components
- [ ] A github workflow for linting & running tests
- [ ] A docker compose for running the app containers

## 🔍 Tech Analysis
- Seperated Dockerfile for frontend and backend
- Seperated Github workflow files for frontend and backed
- Github workflow files are tiggered apon push to feat/* branches & pull request to dev branch
- Workflow steps are install dependencies > run linting > run tests
- Docker compose includes both frontend & backend containers, as well as mariadb
- Environment variables injected via local .env files for dev, and Github secrets for public

logs.description: Set up the dockerfiles for both frontend and backend.
logs.reflection:
Ran into Prisma related errors when trying to run the docker image "Issue: error: Argument "url" is missing in data source block "db". error" 
The errors were related to a mismatch between the prisma package and the prisma client. They both needed to be version >=7.

logs.description: Created two workflows (backend & frontend) with 3 triggers: push feat & /backend; on pull request on dev branch; workflow dispatch (manual).
Created a docker compose file at project root with frontend, backend, db containers; added project root env and env example files
